business: India's No.1 wires and cables manufacturer serving industrial, retail and institutional customers. Also operates FMEG (consumer electrical goods) and EPC (power infrastructure projects). Makes money through product sales across domestic and export markets with backward integration.

segments.name: Cables and Wires
segments.comment: Market leader, 30-31% organized share, strong domestic/export

segments.name: Fast-Moving Electrical Goods
segments.comment: 25% YoY growth, turned profitable; consumer electronics

revenue_mix: Domestic cables/wires dominant; exports to 90+ countries (₹15.7Bn, 5.4%); institutional and project-based complement retail distribution
strategy: Project Spring: Five-year transformation to FY2029-30 for growth
Digital DNA: AI and loyalty apps for retail engagement
Expand W&C organized market share consolidation domestically
FMEG expansion targeting top 3 in key segments
Build international presence via supply chain diversification
outlook: Strong growth momentum expected, anchored by W&C market leadership. Supported by infrastructure investments, power sector growth, renewable energy, real estate upcycle, and electrification. Positioned to consolidate domestic market leadership.
capex_plans: ₹14,799 Mn in FY26. Continuing capacity expansion through internal accruals to support Project Spring.
risks: Global trade protectionism and tariff impacts on exports
Commodity price volatility (copper, aluminium, PVC, steel)
Geopolitical tensions affecting Middle East operations and shipping
flags: Note 46 of standalone financials contains restatement reference; no auditor qualifications or related-party issues disclosed.
